Tool Capability

Tool capability using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

tool_capability(required, available)

Example input

{
  "required": [
    "edit",
    "test"
  ],
  "available": [
    "test"
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "status": "BLOCKED",
  "missing": [
    "edit"
  ]
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py tool_capability < examples/tool-capability.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
